consent.title: Cookies and error replay
consent.body: We only use what is needed to run Vibed, plus one optional tool: when the editor hits an error, a short replay of the screen helps us fix it. Text, images and video are hidden in these replays.

unsubscribe.title: Email preferences
unsubscribe.body: Stop receiving the weekly summary and product updates from Vibed. You will still get emails about your account, such as payment receipts and notices before projects are deleted.
